title: Aniimo Daily Activity Guide | Rewards, Reset Time, Primegy And Stamp Rush | Aniimo Guide
description: A full guide to Aniimo's Daily Activity: how to unlock it, the five tasks, the five reward packs, the four AM reset, how Primegy works and how Stamp Rush fits in. Checked against several guides in October 2026.

sections.heading: The daily habit that pays
sections.script: If you play Aniimo every day, there is one menu you should open before anything else, the Daily Activity page. It takes only a few minutes, and the rewards are surprisingly good. Guides say the five reward packs give a total of three thousand Safaris EXP a day, plus eggs, Glimmer, Growth Fruits and capture pods. In this video we explain how to unlock Daily Activity, what the five tasks are, how the points work, what is inside each pack, and how Primegy and Stamp Rush fit in. We will not repeat our roadmap or our beginner guide, so this video is only about the daily routine. A warning as usual. Numbers can change with patches, so use the screen in your own game as the final word.

sections.heading: How to unlock it
sections.script: Daily Activity does not appear from the very first minute. Guides say you unlock it during the main quest, after you defeat and catch the Alpha Aniimo Turbo. That happens roughly half an hour into your first session. This quest also gives you the Institute Guide, which is the menu that holds the daily page. You can open it with the F4 key on PC, or with the fourth icon in the top right corner. Daily Activity is the first tab. If you cannot find it yet, do not worry. Keep following the story until you meet Turbo, and the menu will open up. Once it is open, it becomes part of your daily check, just like Elite Training, which you should also open and claim from every day.

sections.heading: The five daily tasks
sections.script: There are five tasks, and together they are worth seven hundred points. Logging in is worth one hundred points and completes by itself. Spending sixty Primegy is worth two hundred points. Catching five Aniimo is worth one hundred points, and guides say repeat species count, so you do not need five new ones. Taking one photo with an Aniimo is worth one hundred points, and Photo Mode opens with the F7 key. Finally, collecting fifty Season Stamps is worth two hundred points. Notice something nice about this list. The reward packs unlock at five hundred points, but the total is seven hundred, so you can skip any single task and still unlock everything. If the stamp task looks annoying, you can ignore it on a busy day.

sections.heading: The five reward packs
sections.script: Now the rewards. Each pack unlocks at five hundred points on the daily track, and every pack also gives six hundred Safaris EXP, which is character experience. That is where the three thousand number comes from. The First Activity Stamp Gift Pack contains ten Windborn Stamps and three hundred Companion EXP. The Activity EXP Gift Pack gives ten Growth Fruits and four hundred Companion EXP. The Activity Catch Gift Pack gives ten Aniipod Hyper and five hundred Companion EXP. The Activity Glimmer Gift Pack gives thirty Glimmer. And the Active Aniimo Egg Pack gives an Incredible Egg. That egg is important for breeders, because an Incredible Egg guarantees at least Elite potential, as we explained in our eggs and Homeland video.

sections.heading: The daily reset
sections.script: When does everything refresh? Guides say the daily reset happens at four in the morning, server time. That means different real world times for different regions. The listed servers are Asia Pacific at UTC plus eight, Europe at UTC plus one, and America at UTC minus five. After the reset, every task returns to zero and the reward packs can be claimed again. Another guide also warns that unclaimed packs do not carry over to the next day, so do not leave rewards sitting there. If you play late at night, check what time the reset falls in your own time zone.

sections.heading: What Primegy is
sections.script: Two of the daily tasks use Primegy, so let us explain it. Primegy is an energy resource. Guides say it comes back at one point every six minutes. You spend it when you challenge or catch Alpha Aniimo. One test battle in a guide cost thirty Primegy, so a single Alpha try uses a good chunk of it. That is why the sixty Primegy task is easy to complete without much thought. Just do two Alpha fights during the day, and it is done. But guides also warn you not to farm Alpha bosses only for Safaris EXP. Repeat clears give much less than first clears, and the energy is better spent on a boss you really need, for example one that drops an evolution material.

sections.heading: Smart ways to combine tasks
sections.script: The best players do not treat these five tasks as five separate chores. They combine them. Guides suggest that fighting and catching Alpha Aniimo works for several tasks at once. It spends your Primegy, it counts toward catching five Aniimo, and it earns stamp points. Another tip is to take your photo right after a catch, while the creature is still next to you. And log in early in the day to bank the free one hundred points. One more habit helps a lot. Plan your route before you leave, and group nearby goals together, instead of crossing the map again and again. A single trip to a region can finish your daily catches, an Elite Training goal and a collection target in one loop.

sections.heading: Stamp Rush explained
sections.script: The Season Stamps task needs a short explanation. Stamps come from an event called Stamp Rush. Guides list four ways to earn stamp points. You can claim Bloom rewards in Wild Surge, defeat Alpha Aniimo, clear stages in the Holo Battle Sim, or attend the Star Crossed Tea Party. The tea party takes place at ChillBeanz in Astra, every night from six in the evening until two in the morning, and you earn points by resting there. Stamp Rush resets every week, and it has a cap of one thousand stamp points per week. Because of that cap, spread your activities across the week instead of rushing everything on one day. Windborn Stamps from the daily packs can be spent in the Stamp Shop.

sections.heading: A ten minute routine
sections.script: Here is a simple routine that uses everything we covered. Log in and open the Institute Guide with F4. Claim any rewards that are ready from yesterday. Open Elite Training and claim whatever you have completed, because those rewards do not collect themselves. Then go for an Alpha you have not beaten, or one that drops a material you need. Catch a few Aniimo on the way, and take a quick photo. Check the Stamp Rush event if one is running. Finally, claim your packs, and send the Incredible Egg to the Hatchinator. That whole routine can fit into a short session, and over a week it adds up to many thousands of experience points, plus eggs and Glimmer.

sections.heading: What is your daily routine
sections.script: That is our guide to Daily Activity in Aniimo. Remember the basics. Five tasks, seven hundred points, five hundred needed per pack, and a reset at four in the morning server time. Combine your Alpha fights, catches and photo into one loop, and keep an eye on the weekly stamp cap. Now we want to hear from you. What does your daily routine look like, and which of the five packs do you value most? Tell us in the comments.
